people.name: Manuel Teixeira Gomes
people.nameZh: 曼努埃爾·特謝拉·戈梅斯

body.zh-Hant: 曼努埃爾·特謝拉·戈梅斯1860年5月27日生於維拉諾瓦·德波爾蒂芒，父母為若澤·利巴尼奧·戈梅斯與瑪麗亞·達格洛里亞·特謝拉·戈梅斯。父親是富有的地主，大規模經營乾果貿易。他10歲時被送往科英布拉神學院，服完兵役後遷居波爾圖，1899年出版首部作品《六月清單》。
body.en: Manuel Teixeira Gomes was born on 27 May 1860 in Vila Nova de Portimão, the son of José Libânio Gomes and Maria da Glória Teixeira Gomes. His father was a wealthy landowner who traded dried fruit on a large scale. At the age of ten he was sent to the seminary of Coimbra; after military service he moved to Porto, and in 1899 his first book, O Inventário de Junho, appeared.

citations.quote: Nasceu a 27 de Maio de 1860, em Vila Nova de Portimão.
Era filho de José Libânio Gomes e de Maria da Glória Teixeira Gomes.
o pai dedicava-se ao comércio de frutos secos em larga escala
Aos 10 anos, como era uso nas famílias abastadas da época
é enviado para o Seminário de Coimbra
Após ter cumprido o serviço militar, vai viver para o Porto
primeira obra O Inventário de Junho, que aparece a público em 1899

heading.zh-Hant: 駐英公使與國際聯盟代表
heading.en: Minister in London and League of Nations delegate

body.zh-Hant: 共和國成立後，他受邀出任葡萄牙駐倫敦公使，1911年4月前往英國，10月11日向喬治五世遞交國書。他參與葡萄牙參加一戰的談判，卻因此在西多尼奧·派斯執政期間被免職；1919年曾任駐馬德里公使，不久復任倫敦。1922年他獲任葡萄牙駐國際聯盟代表，並擔任副主席之一。
body.en: After the Republic was established he was invited to serve as Portugal's minister in London; he went to Britain in April 1911 and presented his credentials to George V on 11 October. He took part in matters concerning Portugal's entry into the Great War, which cost him his post under Sidónio Pais; in 1919 he was minister in Madrid and soon returned to London. In 1922 he was named Portugal's delegate to the League of Nations and served as one of its vice-presidents.

desempenhando as funções de um dos seus vice-presidentes

body.zh-Hant: 1923年8月6日，他在國會會議第三輪投票當選共和國總統，121票支持他，只有5票投給貝爾納迪諾·馬沙多；同年10月就任。任內內閣更迭頻繁，他認為自己無權在法定框架內干預，於1925年12月11日辭去總統職務，17日搭乘希臘客輪「宙斯」號離開葡萄牙。
body.en: On 6 August 1923 he was elected President of the Republic by the Congress; in the third ballot 121 voted for him and only 5 for Bernardino Machado, and he took office in October that year. Governments changed constantly during his term, and feeling he lacked the powers to act within the constitutional framework, he resigned on 11 December 1925 and on the 17th left Portugal aboard the Greek liner Zeus.

resigna do seu mandato, em 11 de Dezembro de 1925

um improvável Presidente da República que se demite sem drama

body.zh-Hant: 1931年他定居阿爾及利亞的布吉，在那裡度過最後十年，繼續為《魔鬼報》與《新種子》雜誌撰稿。他於1941年10月18日逝世，1950年10月16日應家屬要求，遺骸移葬波爾蒂芒的墓地。
body.en: In 1931 he settled in Bougie, Algeria, where he spent his last ten years and continued to write for the newspaper O Diabo and the review Seara Nova. He died there on 18 October 1941; on 16 October 1950, at his family's request, his remains were moved to the cemetery of Portimão.

heading.en: Origins and the party's control commission

body.zh-Hant: 洛索林·拉甘（俄文拼作Лааган）生於1887年，原為喇嘛。1928年在人民革命黨第七次代表大會上，他當選為黨中央監察委員會主席。
body.en: Losolyn Laagan (spelled Лааган in Russian) was born in 1887 and was formerly a lama. In 1928, at the seventh congress of the Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party, he was elected chairman of the party's Central Control Commission.

citations.quote: Л. Лааган (1887–1940 гг.) ― также бывший лама
в 1928 г. на VII съезде партии избран председателем ЦКК МНРП

heading.en: Chairman of the Presidium of the Little Khural

body.zh-Hant: 1930年，在第六屆大呼拉爾上他當選為小呼拉爾主席團主席。研究引述觀察者Я.Л. Гроссман的記載，這位小呼拉爾主席（俄文拼作Лаган）除了接受歐式治療外，也求助藏醫（emchi）。
body.en: In 1930, at the Sixth Great Khural, he was elected chairman of the Presidium of the Little Khural. A study cites the observer Ya. L. Grossman as recording that the chairman of the Little Khural (spelled Лаган in Russian) turned to Tibetan physicians (emchi) as an additional measure alongside European treatment.

citations.quote: VI Великом народном хурале (1930 г.) ― председателем президиума Малого хурала

body.zh-Hant: 俄羅斯學者指出，文中所舉的黨與國家人物，除喬巴山外都遭到鎮壓，拉甘也在其列。1996年9月12日，蒙古國政府決議把科布多省布揚特蘇木的中學，以「國家與社會活動家」洛索林·拉甘的名字命名。
body.en: A Russian scholar notes that the party and state figures she discusses, apart from Choibalsan, were all repressed, and Laagan is among them. By a resolution of 12 September 1996 the Mongolian government named the secondary school of Buyant sum in Khovd aimag after Losolyn Laagan, a state and social figure.

body.zh-Hant: 恩格爾伯特·陶爾斐斯1892年10月4日生於下奧地利的特克辛，出身小農家庭。一戰時他志願從軍，1919至1920年在維也納與柏林完成學業，隨後在下奧地利農民聯盟任秘書，1927年起出任下奧地利邦農業會議所主任。
body.en: Engelbert Dollfuß was born on 4 October 1892 in Texing, Lower Austria, into a small-farm family. He volunteered for war service in the First World War, completed his studies in Vienna and Berlin in 1919–20, then worked as secretary of the Lower Austrian Farmers' League and from 1927 as director of the Lower Austrian provincial chamber of agriculture.

citations.quote: Texing bei Mank (N.Ö.), 4. 10. 1892
Aus einer Kleinbauernfamilie
meldete sich als Kriegsfreiwilliger
vollendete D. 1919-20 seine Studien in Wien und Berlin
Sekretär des Niederösterreichischen Bauernbundes
1927 Amtsdir. der N.ö. Landeslandwirtschaftskammer

body.zh-Hant: 1930年10月，他出任奧地利聯邦鐵路總裁；1931年3月18日進入內閣，擔任聯邦土地與林業部長；1932年5月20日成為聯邦總理，並兼任外交部長。同年8月30日，洛桑貸款協議獲得通過。
body.en: In October 1930 Dollfuß became president of the Austrian Federal Railways; on 18 March 1931 he entered the cabinet as Federal Minister of Agriculture and Forestry, and on 20 May 1932 he became Federal Chancellor, also taking the foreign ministry. On 30 August 1932 the Lausanne loan agreement was adopted.

citations.quote: Oktober: Dollfuß wird Präsident der Österreichischen Bundesbahn.
Bundesminister für Land- und Forstwirtschaft 18.03.1931-20.05.1932
und wurde am 20.5.1932 Bundeskanzler
im Mai 1932 außerdem Bundeskanzler und Min. des Äußeren
Am 30.8.1932 wurde der Anleihevertrag von Lausanne angenommen

body.zh-Hant: 1933年3月4日國民議會停擺，陶爾斐斯藉機以緊急命令推動國家改造。同年5月20日成立祖國陣線，6月19日禁止納粹黨，8月19至20日他在里喬內與墨索里尼達成協議。10月30日他遭槍擊未遂。
body.en: After the National Council was put out of action on 4 March 1933, Dollfuß used the opportunity to remodel the state by emergency decree. The Patriotic Front was founded on 20 May 1933, the Nazi party was banned on 19 June, and on 19–20 August he reached agreements with Mussolini at Riccione. An attempt on his life with a revolver was made on 30 October.

citations.quote: Am 4.3.1933 setzte sich durch einen formalen Abstimmungsfehler
nützte dies zu einem Versuch des Staatsumbaus
mit Hilfe von Notverordnungen

am 19.6.1933 das Verbot der NSDAP

body.zh-Hant: 1934年2月12日國家危機爆發，社會民主黨遭禁。3月17日，奧地利、義大利與匈牙利簽署羅馬議定書；5月1日他公布新憲法，終結政黨國家體制。7月25日，他在納粹政變中於總理府遇害。
body.en: The state crisis broke out on 12 February 1934 and led to the ban of the Social Democratic Party. On 17 March Austria, Italy and Hungary concluded the Rome Protocols; on 1 May he proclaimed the new constitution, ending the party state. On 25 July he was murdered in the Federal Chancellery during the Nazi putsch.
